definitions.explanation: Travel that takes place during nighttime hours, or a train/bus that operates overnight.
Being active at night, especially referring to animals that are nocturnal.

examples.japanese: {夜行|やこう}バスで{大阪|おおさか}に{行|い}った。
examples.english: I went to Osaka by overnight bus.

examples.japanese: {夜行|やこう}{列車|れっしゃ}は{安|やす}いが{疲|つか}れる。
examples.english: Night trains are cheap but tiring.

examples.japanese: {学生|がくせい}のころはよく{夜行|やこう}バスで{旅行|りょこう}していた。
examples.english: When I was a student, I often traveled by overnight bus.

examples.japanese: {夜行|やこう}{便|びん}は{朝|あさ}{早|はや}く{着|つ}くので、{時間|じかん}を{有効|ゆうこう}に{使|つか}える。
examples.english: Overnight services arrive early in the morning, so you can use your time effectively.

examples.japanese: {猫|ねこ}は{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}だ。
フクロウは{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}の{鳥|とり}です。
{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}の{動物|どうぶつ}は{暗|くら}い{中|なか}でも{目|め}が{見|み}える。
examples.english: Nocturnal animals can see even in the dark.

examples.japanese: ハムスターは{夜行|やこう}{性|せい}なので、{昼間|ひるま}はずっと{寝|ね}ている。
examples.english: Hamsters are nocturnal, so they sleep all day.

examples.japanese: {夜行|やこう}{性|せい}の{虫|むし}は{光|ひかり}に{集|あつ}まる{習性|しゅうせい}があるので、{夜|よる}に{窓|まど}を{開|あ}けると{入|はい}ってくる。
examples.english: Nocturnal insects have a habit of gathering around light, so they come in when you open the window at night.

notes:
USAGE: {夜行|やこう} often appears in compound words related to overnight transportation.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
・{夜行|やこう}バス (overnight bus)
・{夜行|やこう}{列車|れっしゃ} (night train)
・{夜行|やこう}{性|せい} (nocturnal - for animals)
・{夜行|やこう}{便|びん} (overnight flight/service)

CONTRAST:
・{夜行|やこう} vs {日帰|ひがえ}り - overnight travel vs day trip
